result.instructions: Tools for Helpjuice, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of our help articles are still drafts, and which categories hold them?"; "Search our knowledge base for articles about refunds and show their categories."; "Who edited our billing articles in the last month, according to the activity log?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Helpjuice data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run helpjuice_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run helpjuice_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run helpjuice_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. helpjuice_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: helpjuice_search_articles
tools.title: Search articles
tools.description: Search the knowledge base by keyword, optionally inside one category. Returns article ids, names, short answer samples, categories and URLs. Helpjuice API: GET /api/v3/search.

category_id.description: Only search articles in this category id.

tools.name: helpjuice_list_articles
tools.title: List articles
tools.description: List articles, filtered by category, publish state, access level, language or update dates. Use it to find stale or unpublished content. Helpjuice API: GET /api/v3/articles.

category_id.description: Only articles in this category id.

is_published.description: true = published only, false = drafts only.

language.description: Language short code, for example en_us.

updated_since.description: Date filter in the format the API accepts, for example 20-09-2021.

updated_upto.description: Date filter in the format the API accepts, for example 20-09-2021.

tools.name: helpjuice_get_article
tools.title: Get an article
tools.description: Get one article by id, including its body, categories, publish state, views and author details. Helpjuice API: GET /api/v3/articles/{id}.

article_id.description: The article id (from helpjuice_list_articles or helpjuice_search_articles).

tools.name: helpjuice_list_categories
tools.title: List categories
tools.description: List the knowledge base categories (the sections readers browse). Helpjuice API: GET /api/v3/categories.

tools.name: helpjuice_get_category
tools.title: Get a category
tools.description: Get one category by id. Helpjuice API: GET /api/v3/categories/{id}.

tools.name: helpjuice_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List the users of the knowledge base, with their roles and groups. Filter by email, name or role. Helpjuice API: GET /api/v3/users.

tools.name: helpjuice_get_user
tools.title: Get a user
tools.description: Get one user by id, with role and contact fields. Helpjuice API: GET /api/v3/users/{id}.

tools.name: helpjuice_list_groups
tools.title: List groups
tools.description: List the user groups of the knowledge base. Helpjuice API: GET /api/v3/groups.

tools.name: helpjuice_list_group_users
tools.title: List group members
tools.description: List the users in one group. Helpjuice API: GET /api/v3/groups/{id}/users.

tools.name: helpjuice_list_activities
tools.title: List activity
tools.description: List the account activity log: who changed what and when. trackable_id and action_type need trackable_type. Helpjuice API: GET /api/v3/activities.

trackable_type.description: The kind of item, for example Article.

action_type.description: The action, for example update. Needs trackable_type.

owner_id.description: Only activity done by this user id.

older_than.description: Only activity before this activity id.

tools.name: helpjuice_get_account_settings
tools.title: Get account settings
tools.description: Get the account name, subdomain, internal-KB flag and contact settings. Helpjuice API: GET /api/v3/settings/account.

tools.name: helpjuice_create_article
tools.title: Create an article
tools.description: Create an article in one or more categories. It is a draft unless published is true; published true makes it visible to readers at once. Helpjuice API: POST /api/v3/articles.

category_ids.description: The main category id first, then any also-in categories.

description.description: A short description of the article.

codename.description: The URL slug of the article.

tools.name: helpjuice_update_article
tools.title: Update an article
tools.description: Change an article. Only the fields you pass change. Setting published changes what readers see. Keys whose role cannot publish save changes as drafts for review. Helpjuice API: PUT /api/v3/articles/{id}.

category_ids.description: The categories the article is in.

description.description: A short description of the article.

codename.description: The URL slug of the article.

prompts.description: What you can do with Helpjuice here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: find_unpublished_or_stale_articles

prompts.name: search_the_knowledge_base_by_keyword

prompts.description: Search the articles by keyword, optionally inside one category, then open an article to read its full text.

prompts.name: check_who_edited_the_articles
prompts.title: Check who edited the articles
prompts.description: Read the activity log to see who changed which article and when, then look up the editor's user record.

prompts.name: draft_a_new_article
prompts.title: Draft a new article
prompts.description: Create an article in one or more categories. It stays a draft unless you set it to published.

prompts.name: update_an_existing_article

prompts.description: Change the fields you pass in an article. Setting it to published changes what readers see.
